title: Accelerated Proximal Gradient Methods for Multiobjective Optimization over Probability Measures via Hilbert-Space Lifting
abstract: arXiv:2611.34073v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many sampling and inference tasks require a single distribution that balances several targets. We formulate this task as multiobjective optimization of Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergences over probability measures, in the Pareto sense. The particle method MWGraD (Nguyen et al., 2025) uses explicit Wasserstein gradient steps, and its accelerated version A-MWGraD (Nguyen et al., 2026) lacks discrete-time guarantees. We propose the multiobjective Wasserstein proximal gradient (MWPG), which uses implicit Wasserstein gradient steps, and its accelerated version, multiobjective Wasserstein accelerated proximal gradient (MWAPG), with rigorous discrete-time guarantees. Our key idea is a Hilbert-space lifting: each measure is represented as the pushforward of a fixed base measure by a map in a Hilbert space. translated_title: 通过希尔伯特空间提升的概率测度上多目标优化的加速近端梯度方法
translated_abstract: 许多采样和推断任务需要一个能够平衡多个目标的单一分布。我们将该任务表述为在概率测度上对Kullback-Leibler (KL)散度进行Pareto意义下的多目标优化。粒子方法MWGraD（Nguyen等，2025）使用显式Wasserstein梯度步，而其加速版本A-MWGraD（Nguyen等，2026）缺乏离散时间保证。我们提出了使用隐式Wasserstein梯度步的多目标Wasserstein近端梯度方法（MWPG），以及其加速版本——具有严格离散时间保证的多目标Wasserstein加速近端梯度方法（MWAPG）。我们的核心思想是希尔伯特空间提升：每个测度被表示为希尔伯特空间中一个映射对固定基础测度的推前。该问题由此转化为关于传输映射的约束多目标复合优化问题，从而可以应用加速近端梯度方法求解。
tldr: 本文提出基于希尔伯特空间提升的多目标Wasserstein近端梯度方法（MWPG）及其加速版本（MWAPG），通过隐式Wasserstein梯度步求解概率测度上KL散度的Pareto多目标优化问题，并提供严格的离散时间收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes multiobjective Wasserstein proximal gradient (MWPG) and its accelerated version (MWAPG) based on Hilbert-space lifting, solving Pareto multiobjective optimization of KL divergences over probability measures via implicit Wasserstein gradient steps with rigorous discrete-time convergence guarantees.
